card.name: 'Under' before law or legal authority
card.fires_on: The word 'under' (or 'by') right before a legal or governing authority, such as 'under international law' or 'under a mandate'. It also fires weakly on digits inside historical years like 1840 or 1603.

modes.label: Under + legal authority
modes.description: 'Under' introducing a law, treaty, mandate or arrangement in a political or historical text.
modes.example: These settlements – colonies and squatter camps, in fact – are illegal<< under>> international law and, with their rapid expansion

modes.label: Digits in historical years
modes.description: The third digit of a 19th- or 17th-century year in a historical passage.
modes.example: The district was created in 1<<8>>34 when Prussia bought the L

card.writes: It pushes up 'international' in several languages, as in 'under international law'.
card.plain: It spots the word 'under' just before a law or treaty and predicts that 'international' comes next.
